selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Where did the traveler want to go next to learn more about Allah?
questions.answer: He wanted to enter the world of people.

questions.question: Which realm did he decide to enter next?
questions.answer: He decided to enter the realm of human beings.

questions.question: What shows that their message was not weak or doubtful?
questions.answer: Their many clear miracles showed it was strong.

questions.question: What were they calling people toward?
questions.answer: They were calling people to faith in Allah.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give for learning from the prophets?
questions.answer: It gives the picture of a shining school.

questions.question: Who gave the prophets their miracles?
questions.answer: The Creator of all things gave them.

questions.question: What showed that many people trusted the prophets?
questions.answer: Big groups of people believed them and accepted their message.

questions.question: Why was their witness important?
questions.answer: Because truthful people agreeing together makes the truth strong.

questions.question: Give one reason from the passage, besides miracles, that supports the prophets.
questions.answer: Their true teachings, their strong faith, or their serious effort supports them.

questions.question: What does the agreement of all prophets add to their message?
questions.answer: It makes their message even more powerful.

questions.question: What was the traveler trying to do in his journey of learning?
questions.answer: He was trying to go higher in knowing Allah.

questions.question: How did humanity welcome the traveler?
questions.answer: They invited him in.

questions.question: What did he notice when he looked at earlier times?
questions.answer: He noticed that all the prophets shared the same message.

questions.question: The passage compares learning from the prophets to being in what kind of place?
questions.answer: It compares it to being in a bright school.

questions.question: How did the traveler behave when he entered their school?
questions.answer: He sat humbly and listened to the teaching.

questions.question: What kind of human beings are the prophets described as?
questions.answer: They are the best and most honored of people.

questions.question: What does it say about the people who accepted the prophets’ message?
questions.answer: They were many, serious, and truthful.

questions.question: What did he understand about people who reject this truth?
questions.answer: They were making a very serious mistake and a great wrong.

questions.question: What did he think about those who believe?
questions.answer: He thought they were true and righteous people.

questions.question: How did the prophets and their followers stand with one another?
questions.answer: They agreed, helped one another, and were close in purpose.

questions.question: What new group did the traveler want to enter after earlier stages of learning?
questions.answer: He wanted to enter the realm of humanity.

questions.question: Who invited him there?
questions.answer: Humanity, with the prophets at the front, invited him.

questions.question: What were the prophets saying together?
questions.answer: They were declaring that Allah is the only God.

questions.question: What act of worship were the prophets also doing?
questions.answer: They were remembering Allah.
